_meta.note: Story video v8. 'at' = voice start in seconds. v8 re-voiced only the 'agent' line (Kokoro af_heart, PyTorch) and spliced it into the v7 mix.
_meta.say: 'say' is what the voice reads when it differs from the caption: Qloo is pronounced "clue".

lines.text: Maya isn't on Qloo yet. But Qloo knows the fans of the artists Maya sounds like.
lines.say: Maya isn't on Clue yet. But Clue knows the fans of the artists Maya sounds like.

lines.text: So tell Tour Scout who Maya sounds like.
Here, real Qloo data for the fans of Joanna Sternberg lights up where they actually are.
lines.say: Here, real Clue data for the fans of Joanna Sternberg lights up where they actually are.

lines.text: Tour Scout keeps it drivable: the strongest cities within a day's drive of each other.
Each stop gets real rooms these fans favour, and a support slot with an act their size whose fans share their taste.
Plus the request, addressed to that act's team, ready to fill in.
Then an agent checks the plan with Qloo tools. It finds a stronger city that's also a shorter drive: Providence over Albany. Apply, and the route redraws.
lines.say: Then an agent checks the plan with Clue tools. It finds a stronger city that's also a shorter drive: Providence over Albany. Apply, and the route redraws.

lines.text: On a comedy club run, it says the route holds, and shows why.
On a phone, the check opens by itself.
Streaming dashboards show where your listeners are. Qloo shows where your fans could be: the rooms, the openers, even the sponsors.
lines.say: Streaming dashboards show where your listeners are. Clue shows where your fans could be: the rooms, the openers, even the sponsors.

lines.text: And every claim links to the exact Qloo request behind it.
lines.say: And every claim links to the exact Clue request behind it.

lines.text: Under the hood: a plan you can audit, built on Qloo's official harness, Claude Haiku for the words, guards on every claim, and an agent whose answers the server checks against its own numbers.
lines.say: Under the hood: a plan you can audit, built on Clue's official harness, Claude Haiku for the words, guards on every claim, and an agent whose answers the server checks against its own numbers.

lines.text: Tour Scout. Find your fans before you book the room.
